title: pmstring_1d
description: `pmstring_1d` is a simple physical model of a string made from moving masses, intended to create multiple correlated control outputs from a few inputs. Its arguments set the number of moving masses, rigidity, and damping; its inlets control the positions of the first and last masses, apply forces to masses using a list such as `3 1`, and adjust rigidity and damping, while its list outlets report mass positions.
